jobs.title: Financial Analyst
jobs.location: Abu Dhabi, Abu Dhabi Emirate, United Arab Emirates
jobs.description:
Company Description
AL JABER SIGN'S LLC is a signage and visual communication company based in Abu Dhabi, serving a wide range of commercial and industrial clients. The company focuses on delivering high-quality, customized signage solutions that support brand visibility and customer engagement. Operations include project planning, design, production, and installation, requiring strong coordination across technical and administrative teams. Joining AL JABER SIGN'S LLC offers exposure to diverse projects and a dynamic business environment with opportunities for professional development in finance and operations.
Role Description
The Financial Analyst role at AL JABER SIGN'S LLC is a full-time, on-site position based in Abu Dhabi. The role involves analyzing financial data, preparing regular reports, and supporting budgeting and forecasting activities to inform management decisions. The Financial Analyst will review financial statements, monitor key performance indicators, and identify trends, variances, and improvement opportunities. Daily tasks include collaborating with operations and management teams to evaluate project profitability, supporting cost-control initiatives, and ensuring accurate, timely financial reporting. The role also contributes to financial planning, assists with annual budgets, and helps maintain compliance with internal policies and relevant financial standards.
Qualifications

Strong Finance knowledge with practical experience in Financial Planning and Financial Reporting.
Ability to work with Financial Statements and interpret results for management and operational teams.
Solid Analytical Skills, including proficiency in data analysis, variance analysis, and trend identification.
Proficiency in spreadsheet and financial modeling tools (e.g., Excel, financial analysis software).
Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, or a related field; professional certifications (e.g., CFA, CPA) are an advantage.
Attention to detail, strong organizational skills, and the ability to manage multiple deadlines in a fast-paced environment.
Effective communication skills and the ability to present financial insights to non-finance stakeholders.
Experience in manufacturing, construction, signage, or related industries in the region is a plus.
